name: Spell Fracture Gloves
body:
Aura moderate abjuration; CL 11th Slot hands; Price 36,000 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

These gloves allow the wearer to pay 2 points from one random ability score as part of casting a spell in order to add her casting modifier to his check to overcome spell resistance. In addition if the wearer rolls a natural 20 on a check to overcome spell resistance or confirms a critical hit with a spell that requires an attack roll she may spend a swift action to cast dispel magic or greater dispel magic on that target. If the wearer is an invoker then they may choose to deal their mystic blast damage to a target that they have successfully dispelled an active spell effect on, a Will save (DC + ½ invoker level + Charisma modifier) negates this damage.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells dispel magic or rechannel spell, quicken spell or quickened pact magic; Cost 18,000 gp.
